tracks.title: Discipline
tracks.summary: Plan your day in time blocks, log what you did, keep your score and streak, and pin your top five on the Focus board.
tracks.overview:
**Discipline** is a day planner built for people who drift. You lay the day out in **time blocks**, the page follows the clock, and your agents' work checks the boxes for you.

- **Day** (`/discipline`). The hero shows the block you are in (or the next one), today's **compliance**, focus minutes and your **day streak**. A quick-log bar records what just happened. With **auto-log** on, agent runs and finished kanban tasks are logged against the active block, the day starts itself on your first activity and a block completes when work lands inside it.
- **Blocks and routines.** Each block has a category, an intent, days it repeats, hard-lock / non-negotiable flags and an optional daily routine checklist (your habits for that block).
- **Templates.** Save a layout ("Workday", "Weekend") and load or append it later. Built-in presets get you started.
- **Score and Settings.** Day and week scores, trends and analytics; Telegram block messages, the AI assistant, the day window, quiet hours and Notion sync.
- **Focus board** (`/focus`). Up to five tasks or projects you are committing to.
- **Alerts.** Block start / missed alerts, a 09:30 check-in and a 21:00 evening wrap slide in under the topbar clock (and on Telegram if you switch it on).

Agents can drive all of it through the `discipline` and `focus` tools. The tours type into drafts and open dialogs but never save a block, a log or a template.

walkthroughs.title: Read your day at a glance
walkthroughs.summary: The hero, today's score, the quick-log bar and the auto-logged lane.

steps.title: What's on now
steps.body: The hero shows the block you're in and the time left, or the next block and when it starts. With nothing planned it says **Ready when you are**.

steps.title: Today's score
steps.body: **Compliance** is how much of today's planned block time you kept. Next to it are focus minutes today and your **day streak**.

steps.title: Act on the current block
steps.body: During a block you get **Check in** and **Abort**. Otherwise **+ New block** starts a new one.

steps.title: Running late? Start from now
steps.body: **Start from now** shifts every remaining block so the day starts right now, keeping each block's length.

practice.note: The tour doesn't press it: it reschedules your real blocks for today.

steps.title: Log what just happened
steps.body: Type a line here. **Enter** logs it against the active block, and **L** jumps here from anywhere on the page.

steps.title: Pick a category
steps.body: The category defaults to the active block's. Change it when the entry belongs somewhere else. The tour leaves the entry unsaved.

steps.title: Open the Timeline
steps.body: Click **Timeline**. It lays today's blocks and logs on the clock.

steps.title: Work that logs itself
steps.body: With auto-log on, agent runs and finished kanban tasks land here and count against the active block. Your first activity also starts the day.

walkthroughs.title: Plan blocks and routines
walkthroughs.summary: Open the block editor, set a label, days, flags and a routine checklist.

steps.title: Open Blocks
steps.body: Click **Blocks**. It lists every block you have, or starter presets when you have none.

steps.title: Start from a preset
steps.body: With no blocks yet, a preset fills the day with sensible blocks you can edit afterwards. Once you have blocks, this area shows them as a board or a list.

steps.title: Create a block
steps.body: Click the button to open the block editor.

steps.title: Name it
steps.body: Give the block a short label you'll recognise on the timeline.

steps.title: Choose the days
steps.body: Pick the days the block repeats, or use **Weekdays**, **Weekends** or **Every day**.

steps.title: How strict is it?
steps.body: **Hard lock** blocks notifications during the block. **Non-negotiable** means missing it breaks your streak. Untick **Enabled** to pause a block without deleting it.

steps.title: Add a routine item
steps.body: Routines are the habits you run inside a block every day it runs. Click **+ Add routine item**.

steps.title: Write the habit
steps.body: Type a checklist item. Enter adds another one. You tick these off inside the block each day.

steps.title: Saving a block
steps.body: **Create block** saves it to your schedule. You can also link the block to a project or task. This tour cancels instead.

steps.title: Cancel the draft
steps.body: Click **Cancel** to close the editor without saving.

walkthroughs.title: Templates and your score
walkthroughs.summary: Save and load schedule templates, then read your day and week scores.

steps.title: The active template
steps.body: This strip shows which template your day came from, and **Modified** once you change it. It appears on Timeline and Blocks.

steps.title: Save a layout
steps.body: **Save as template** snapshots all your current blocks under a name, like "Workday" or "Build sprint Mondays".

steps.title: Load a template
steps.body: Click **Load…** to browse your templates and the built-in presets.

steps.title: Replace or append
steps.body: Each template can **replace** your current layout or **append** its blocks alongside what you have. **Manage** lets you rename and delete your own templates.

practice.note: The tour doesn't apply a template: that rewrites your real schedule.

steps.title: Close it
steps.body: Click **Close**.

steps.title: Open Score
steps.body: Click **Score**.

steps.title: Day and week scores
steps.body: Today's compliance, the week and your streak sit on top. Below are trends, time logged per category and which blocks you keep or slip.

walkthroughs.title: Alerts, Telegram and quiet hours
walkthroughs.summary: Where block alerts appear and how to tune Telegram, the AI assistant and your day window.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings**. The keyboard shortcut is **4**.

steps.title: Telegram block messages
steps.body: Push block starts, slips and daily reviews to Telegram through your gateway's bot. Set a chat ID here to send them somewhere other than the default chat.

practice.note: The tour doesn't switch Telegram on or send a test message.

steps.title: The AI assistant
steps.body: When it's on, the assistant can plan tomorrow and write a daily review, with your blocks and kanban as context.

steps.title: Day window and quiet hours
steps.body: Set when your day starts and ends, how often probes nudge you, and quiet hours that mute Telegram and audio nudges.

steps.title: Where alerts appear
steps.body: Block alerts slide down under the topbar clock: a 5-minute warning, block start and end, a missed block and the day summary. The owner can switch alerts and auto-log off in Plugins › Discipline.

walkthroughs.title: Pin your top five
walkthroughs.summary: Use the Focus board to commit to at most five tasks or projects.

steps.title: Open the Focus board
steps.body: Discipline has two views: **Day** and **Focus board**. Click **Focus board**.

steps.title: Five slots, no more
steps.body: The counter shows how many of your five slots are filled. The hard limit keeps you honest about what you're actually working on.
steps.checkHint: Waiting for the Focus board to open…

steps.title: Rank them
steps.body: Drag an item into a numbered slot, drag to reorder, and use × to take it off the board.

steps.title: Available items
steps.body: Your kanban projects and tasks. Search, filter by type, or switch to a kanban view.

steps.title: Show only projects
steps.body: Click **Projects** to narrow the list.

steps.title: Quick add
steps.body: The **+** button opens a search box to add any task or project to Focus.

steps.title: Search for something
steps.body: Type at least two characters. Clicking a result adds it to your board; this tour stops before that.

options: Shifts the remaining blocks so they start now, keeping their lengths
Starts a focus timer for 25 minutes
quiz.explain: It reschedules what's left of the day from the current time and preserves each block's duration.

quiz.prompt: How many items can the Focus board hold?
quiz.explain: Focus has five slots. Remove one to add another.

quiz.prompt: Which block flag breaks your streak if you miss the block?
quiz.explain: Hard lock blocks notifications; non-negotiable blocks count against your streak when missed.

quiz.prompt: With auto-log on, what gets logged against the active block without you typing anything?
options: Agent runs and finished kanban tasks
quiz.explain: Auto-log records agent activity and task completions, starts the day on first activity and can complete a block when work lands in it.

quiz.prompt: Where do you add a daily habit checklist such as "phone in the drawer"?
options: In the block editor, under Daily routine
quiz.explain: Routine items belong to a block and show up inside it each day it runs.
